surfaceNarrative.concept: Portable archive is a framework-owned backup/export/import/restore contract surfaced through Clawix Settings/Data with signed-host handling for secrets and human confirmation.

completingSurface.human: Clawix Settings/Data portable archive export, verify, import preview, restore and restore report UI.
completingSurface.programmatic: claw archive plan|export|verify|inspect|import|restore|doctor --json and ClawJS PortableArchive* contracts.

surfaceNarrative.nonInference: This surface does not make Clawix the archive schema steward, authorize plaintext secret export, or bypass signed-host approval for restore-sensitive paths.

resourceContract.startup: Portable archive UI does not start archive work at app launch; it reads status only when the Settings/Data surface is opened or an explicit archive action is requested.
resourceContract.idle: Idle state retains only bounded UI status and no active export/import worker, file watcher, or polling loop.
resourceContract.memory: Archive previews and reports must stay summarized in UI state; large payloads stream through framework/host contracts instead of full in-memory mirrors.
resourceContract.streaming: Long export/import/verify/restore progress uses cancellable, bounded progress events with route-specific backpressure and no unbounded UI fanout.
resourceContract.storage: Portable archive files live under the user-selected archive/export destinations and framework contracts; Clawix stores only host-operational status and approval state.
resourceContract.hotPath: Settings navigation and archive status rendering must remain metadata-only and avoid scanning archive contents on the UI hot path.
resourceContract.scale: Archive item enumeration must use framework previews, windows, or summaries; whole-archive reads require explicit bounded contract evidence.
resourceContract.validation: PortableArchiveSettingsTests, portable_archive_mirror_check.mjs, surface_resource_contract_guard.mjs, and sibling ClawJS portable archive governance check

surfaceNarrative.concept: OpenCode is a framework-owned runtime adapter choice surfaced in Clawix only when the feature flag marks the adapter visible.

completingSurface.human: Clawix runtime adapter selector and model display affordances
completingSurface.programmatic: Framework runtime adapter registry and host policy consumed through Clawix feature visibility checks

surfaceNarrative.nonInference: This interface surface does not make Clawix the runtime adapter steward, bypass framework registry policy, or enable hidden adapters without the feature flag.

resourceContract.startup: The selector does not start an adapter on launch; it reads visible runtime adapter metadata when the settings/runtime surface is shown.
resourceContract.idle: Idle state keeps only selected adapter metadata and feature visibility, not a running adapter process.
resourceContract.memory: The adapter list is bounded by the framework runtime adapter registry and rendered as a small selector model.
resourceContract.streaming: No stream is owned by the selector; active runtime job streams must declare their own route resource contracts.
resourceContract.storage: Selection persists through framework runtime configuration or host policy, not a separate Clawix-owned runtime store.
resourceContract.hotPath: UI routing and selector rendering are the hot path and must remain simple metadata reads.
resourceContract.scale: Designed for tens of adapters; 1,000 entries require searchable/paginated selection, and 100,000 adapters are outside product scope.
resourceContract.validation: node scripts/surface_resource_contract_guard.mjs and Runtime adapter registry tests

resourceContract.startup: No runtime ecosystem scan at Clawix launch.

resourceContract.scale: Session, memory, skill, log and diagnostic lists need limits or cursors.
